history_summary.value: The Ramelsloher was bred in the 1870s near Hamburg by shipowner A.D. Wichmann, who crossed local white farm chickens with Andalusian, Cochin and Spanish stock. It was an important commercial breed in the early 1900s but declined sharply after World War Two, and remains critically endangered today despite a partial recovery.
